url.title: URL
url.description: Notifications are POSTed as JSON to this URL. HTTPS is recommended.
url.httpWarning: This URL is not encrypted. The notification payload will travel in cleartext - use HTTPS whenever the target supports it, and only use HTTP for trusted-network targets on your own LAN.
url.invalid: Enter an absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL without embedded credentials

headers.title: Custom headers
headers.description: Optional JSON object of extra HTTP headers, e.g. an Authorization bearer token. Requires an HTTPS URL.
headers.invalidJson: Enter a flat JSON object of string values, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer token"}
headers.requiresHttps: Custom headers require an HTTPS webhook URL

minSeverity.title: Minimum severity
minSeverity.description: Only notifications at or above this severity are forwarded.

texts.aboutWebhookSettings: Forward system notifications as a JSON POST request to any URL you configure - your own automation server, a chat platform's incoming webhook, or a self-hosted tool such as n8n, Node-RED or Home Assistant.
